docs_discrepancies.docs_claim:
Build the agents container:
```bash
docker build -t *YOUR_NAME_FOR_IMAGE* -f Dockerfile.agents . 
```
Run the agents container:
```bash
docker run --rm --env-file .env *YOUR_NAME_FOR_IMAGE* *REPO_NAME* *DESTINATION_OF_THE_CLONED_REPO*
```
docs_discrepancies.actual_finding: The Dockerfile.agents in the repository does not have an ENTRYPOINT configured to run the orchestrator, it sets an environment variable and runs an entrypoint.sh script which checks for a MOCK environment variable. The actual entrypoint script handles the selection between real and mock orchestrators. The build instructions are partially inaccurate as they suggest a direct run of the orchestrator which is not the case.
